articles.text: Apollo (NYSE:APO) Just Bought EasyJet For £5.7 Billion. Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) has completed a £5.7b acquisition of EasyJet. The transaction adds a major European low cost airline to Apollo's portfolio. The EasyJet deal puts Apollo Global Management directly into the heart of European short haul air travel, a sector closely tied to consumer and business demand for flying. Apollo already invests across private equity, credit, and real assets, and this acquisition adds a large operating airline to that mix. For investors watching...
